name: Ashen Wilds
storyline:
Long ago, a great cataclysm turned the world into a barren wasteland of ash and ruin. The few who survived were scattered across the wilds, forced to fight for every drop of water, every scrap of food, and every breath of safety.
In Ashen Wilds, you awaken with no memory of who you were, armed only with instinct and will. Whispers speak of ancient relics buried beneath the scorched earth, holding the power to reshape the land—or doom it forever. But every step you take draws the attention of predators, human and otherwise, and in this unforgiving world, survival is never guaranteed.
summary: Ashen Wilds is a challenging survival experience set in a ruthless open world. Gather valuable resources, build and expand your base, and face deadly creatures lurking in the shadows. In this world, trust is a luxury – other survivors might be your allies… or your downfall. Every day brings new dangers, every night new horrors. Only those who plan wisely and fight fiercely will survive the Ashen Wilds.
